answer: Watermark kernel: every challenge seed hides a per-key pearl that must surface as a statistical watermark in the answer tokens. A single shared decoder cannot carry 1,000 different watermarks at once, so hollow clones that share one sampler fail or merge to one share. An honest agent runs one independent sampler. Caveat: a farm that truly spins 1,000 isolated processes still passes—this blocks cheap shared-state sybils, not fully provisioned fleets.
